title: pm: give the post-merge governed audit an owner — a weekly scheduled workflow (maintainer)
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (card #33603 part 2, owner of the post-merge governed audit, proposed by PR #33711 and judged sound by at-tier record 6890932729).

## 维护者速读

AGENTS.md 第 14 条把「合并后的受管面审计」定为座位落地的补偿控制。#33603 让审计能分开「低风险技能臂落地」和「Tier H 违规」,但还没人定期跑它。席位巡查规则文件 `lanes/skills.md` 已满(35/35),写不进去;更稳的是一个每周的定时工作流。工作流在 `.github/workflows/**`,由你决定。

## What lands (maintainer's call)

- A scheduled workflow (weekly) runs `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` in its audit mode over the past week's `main` and opens or updates one issue when it reports a BREACH or NOT MEASURED.
- Until then the skills seat runs it on its patrol once a week (no rule carrier binds it; recorded on seat post #7623).

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
